evidence: Has the Wallet label and modifies core wallet database migration routines in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/walletdb.cpp.
rationale: Prevents potential wallet data loss and corruption during legacy-to-descriptor SQLite migration by delaying deletion of original files until new databases are verified. As the description notes, previously MigrateToSQLite 'deletes the original database just to create the sqlite db in the same place', leaving failed migrations half-written and requiring manual backup recovery.
